reviews.summary: ADA identity is clear (Cardano). Fresh official/project-source checks found no current exploit, mainnet outage, exchange disruption, regulatory action, or verified near-term discrete supply event material to this spot setup.

facts.fact: Cardano-node 11.1.3 was released September 29, 2026; its notes describe an IPv4 decoding correction and performance/operational improvements, not a disclosed mainnet compromise or emergency incident. ([github.com](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/releases?after=1.18.0&utm_source=openai))

Cardano’s official news archive lists node 11.1.3 as the recommended SPO release on October 2, 2026, alongside CAP-12 opening for review; this is an operational/governance event, not evidence of a current chain outage. ([cardano.org](https://cardano.org/news/archive/?utm_source=openai))

The Cardano treasury requires governance approval and is subject to a net-change limit; no fresh, verified governance action was found indicating an imminent exceptional ADA distribution. ([cardano.org](https://cardano.org/governance/treasury/?utm_source=openai))

Public GitHub security pages checked showed no published security advisories for the Cardano node-test project; this is limited evidence, but no fresh official exploit disclosure was located. ([github.com](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node-tests/security?utm_source=openai))
